item.title: How to Study the Bible: Approaches, Tools, and a Reader's Mindset
item.description: Understand the Bible deeply: its storyline, key themes, and proven study methods. item.title: Old Testament Overview: The Storyline from Genesis to Malachi
item.description: Lesson 2: Old Testament Overview: The Storyline from Genesis to Malachi This lesson teaches the big storyline of the Old Testament, the thirty-nine books Christians group as the first part of the Bible. Rather than memorizing book names, you will learn the narrative arc the text itself presents, so…

item.title: New Testament Overview: Gospels, Letters, and Revelation
item.description: Lesson 3: New Testament Overview: Gospels, Letters, and Revelation This lesson teaches the storyline and structure of the New Testament's twenty-seven books, continuing the story the Old Testament left waiting. You will learn what each major section contributes and how the parts fit together. The…

item.title: Big Themes: Covenant, Grace, and the Kingdom
item.description: Lesson 4: Big Themes: Covenant, Grace, and the Kingdom This lesson teaches three themes that run through the entire Bible and hold its diverse books together: covenant, grace, and the kingdom. Grasping these gives you a framework for connecting passages that otherwise seem unrelated. Covenant is…

item.title: Jesus: His Life, Parables, and Core Teachings
item.description: Lesson 5: Jesus: His Life, Parables, and Core Teachings This lesson teaches the central figure of the New Testament: Jesus of Nazareth as the Gospels present him — his life's shape, his distinctive teaching method in parables, and the core content of his message. Christians hold Jesus to be both…

item.title: Reading by Genre: Narrative, Poetry, Letters, Prophecy
item.description: Lesson 6: Reading by Genre: Narrative, Poetry, Letters, Prophecy This lesson teaches you to adjust your reading strategy to the Bible's literary genres. A psalm is not making the same kind of claim as a Pauline argument, and much confusion comes from reading every text with the same expectations.…

item.title: Prayer and Devotional Practice
item.description: Lesson 7: Prayer and Devotional Practice This lesson teaches how to build a sustainable practice of prayer and devotion — the personal side of Bible study.
